game.title: Mafia II
game.blurb: Story-driven crime action game in which Vito Scaletta comes home from the war and joins the mob in Empire Bay, from 2K Czech, released 2010-08-24. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Vito rises through the family, chapter by chapter. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). This entry uses the Steam app for Mafia II: Definitive Edition (1030830), the edition on sale; the original is still listed as "Mafia II (Classic)" (50130). Both schemas have the same 67 achievements. The Definitive Edition schema calls the app "RYE" (an internal codename). RAWG's entry is the original 2010 game (id 1416); RAWG also has a separate Definitive Edition entry (id 442855). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0: its Table of Contents lists 15 story chapters plus Characters, Vehicles, Extras and Gameplay, but only "Chapter 6: Time Well Spent" (about 3,500 characters), Controls (about 2,500) and the Table of Contents (about 1,500) are written. So it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. mafiagame.fandom.com answers the API, with about 70 linked pages, including "Joe's Adventures", "Jimmy's Vendetta", "The Betrayal of Jimmy" and several outfit packs; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 67 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements with story-style descriptions ("Finish what you started", "Pay a visit to an old friend", "Learn what it means to be a Scaletta" and others) were put in the main story chapter, which may spoil a little.
